official_sources.title: GDAL gdalbuildvrt mosaic semantics
official_sources.finding: gdalbuildvrt builds a virtual mosaic; target resolution, target-aligned pixels, output extent, source nodata, VRT nodata, masks and overlap order materially affect the resulting pixel stream. Without a pixel function, the last overlapping input supplies the value.
official_sources.limitation: A VRT is derived composition metadata and cannot replace immutable source-tile evidence.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster mosaic
official_sources.finding: gdal raster mosaic checks common raster characteristics; with overlapping inputs and no pixel function, input ordering determines priority, while GDAL 3.12+ can use explicit overlap pixel functions.
official_sources.limitation: Input-order or pixel-function policy must be fixed before target elevations are inspected.

official_sources.title: GDAL VRT driver source mapping
official_sources.finding: VRT bands may contain many SimpleSource or ComplexSource entries with explicit SrcRect/DstRect, nodata, masks and overview behavior; uncovered pixels can become zero if nodata is not defined.
official_sources.limitation: Correct XML structure alone does not prove authoritative tile selection or source-byte identity.

official_sources.title: GDAL GTI raster tile index
official_sources.finding: GTI can virtualize very large tile catalogs, controls overlap compositing through z-order, honours masks/alpha and exposes explicit resolution, extent, datatype, nodata, geotransform and SRS metadata.
official_sources.limitation: GTI metadata must match the actual authoritative tile catalog; the driver does not itself validate survey lineage.

official_sources.title: gdaltindex GTI metadata creation
official_sources.finding: gdaltindex can record target resolution, extent, datatype, nodata, mask and projection rules for GTI use; GDAL recommends setting key metadata rather than inferring it from an arbitrary first tile.
official_sources.limitation: Index generation cannot silently normalize incompatible source tiles.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster index
official_sources.finding: gdal raster index records one feature per input raster with filename and footprint geometry, providing an auditable tile-catalog layer for exact source membership.
official_sources.limitation: Footprint/index membership is not proof of which overlapping tile is authoritative.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster footprint
official_sources.finding: gdal raster footprint derives valid-data polygons from nodata or mask semantics and can store source location, enabling tile valid-coverage QA rather than assuming the rectangular extent is fully valid.
official_sources.limitation: Derived footprint geometry must not mutate source validity or become a substitute for exact pixel masks.

official_sources.title: gdal_footprint valid-data coverage
official_sources.finding: The legacy footprint utility likewise computes polygons from nodata/mask-valid pixels and can select overview or source nodata behavior explicitly.
official_sources.limitation: Overview-based footprints are unsuitable for terminal native-resolution evidence unless explicitly QA-only.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster compare golden dataset
official_sources.finding: gdal raster compare can compare pixel content, size, band properties, nodata, CRS, geotransform, overviews, metadata and binary bytes against a golden reference.
official_sources.limitation: Comparison is meaningful only after the reference and candidate mosaics are bound to the same intended source set and policy.

official_sources.title: gdalcompare legacy golden comparison
official_sources.finding: gdalcompare reports pixel and metadata differences and can expose binary, geotransform, overview, SRS and metadata drift between a golden raster and a replay.
official_sources.limitation: Legacy comparison does not define tile precedence or parcel membership policy.

official_sources.title: gdal_merge overlap precedence
official_sources.finding: gdal_merge documents that the last input image comes out on top in overlap and allows source nodata filtering, showing that input ordering is a numeric result dependency.
official_sources.limitation: Materializing a merge is not authorized as the source of truth unless its exact recipe and source digests are pinned.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster info grid metadata
official_sources.finding: gdal raster info reports raster size, CRS, origin, pixel size, block size, datatype, nodata, unit and overviews, providing the metadata needed to test tile grid congruence before mosaicing.
official_sources.limitation: Reported metadata must still be reconciled against immutable source bytes.

official_sources.title: gdalinfo raster metadata inventory
official_sources.finding: gdalinfo exposes raster size, geotransform, CRS, datatype, block size, nodata, overviews and unit metadata, allowing independent per-tile compatibility checks.
official_sources.limitation: Metadata agreement does not prove pixel-value continuity at seams.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster pixel-info VRT contribution tracing
official_sources.finding: gdal raster pixel-info reports input position, converted column/line, pixel values and, for VRT, the contributing source file or files for a queried pixel.
official_sources.limitation: Point queries are QA probes and do not replace complete seam/tile membership ledgers.

official_sources.title: gdaladdo overview construction
official_sources.finding: gdaladdo builds reduced-resolution overviews using explicit resampling methods, so overview pixels are derived and must not be accepted as terminal native DTM values.
official_sources.limitation: Overview existence is useful for inventory only; terminal height evidence remains full resolution.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip whole-pixel bounds
official_sources.finding: gdal raster clip preserves source resolution, rounds bounds to whole-pixel locations without resampling, and by default errors when requested bounds exceed source extent; outside areas can otherwise become zero or nodata.
official_sources.limitation: Clip bounds still do not define exact parcel membership; they are only an extraction envelope.
